title: How Judging Yourself First Changes the Way You Treat Everyone Else
caption:
Judge yourself first, and watch how gentle you get with everyone else. Most men flip it. A godly man doesn't.

Start every correction with your own name before you say your brother's. Hold yourself to the strictest standard in the room, quietly. Hand out the same grace God gave you on your worst day. And when you do correct someone, aim at the sin, never at the person.

Hard on yourself, gentle with everyone else. That's the order.
